title: Introduction and fundamentals
description: We will begin with planning, visualisation and iterative modelling in experimental design.

title: Sampling and modelling
description: You will examine representative sampling and the general linear model as a framework for analysis.

title: Common statistical tests are linear models
Choosing the right model(s)
description: The lectures cover model assumptions and t-tests within a linear-model framework.

title: Early Feedback Task (5%) — opens Friday at 10 am
Multiple predictors and transformations
description: We will extend linear models to multiple predictors, interactions and transformations.

title: Project launch and pilot study timeline
Controls and revision
description: You will consider controls, fixed effects and random effects before revising Module 1.

title: Refresher and categorical variables
description: We return to the general linear model and categorical explanatory variables.

title: Relationships and binary responses
description: You will distinguish group comparisons from continuous relationships and model binary responses.

title: Model selection and revision
description: This week compares information-theoretic model selection with null-hypothesis testing, followed by Module 2 revision.

title: Multivariate analysis and PCA
description: We will introduce multivariate analysis, principal component analysis and factor analysis.

title: Clustering and multidimensional scaling
description: You will use clustering and nMDS to identify and test multivariate patterns.

title: MANOVA and multivariate revision
description: We will apply MANOVA and revisit the main multivariate methods.

title: Rarefaction and Bayesian analysis
description: The lectures cover rarefaction for diversity comparisons and Bayesian statistical inference.

title: Exam revision
description: You will review the course's experimental-design and modelling concepts for the final exam.
